releaseNotes.en: Added VHS Camcorder, Temporal Lights, and Predator Vision for photos and videos. Improved capture reliability and zoom, with dedicated camera-button support and optional swipe zoom. Added Arabic and an in-app language picker, refreshed the App Store, and kept Wi-Fi Drop transfers running through display sleep.
releaseNotes.zh: 新增 VHS 复古摄像机、流光轨迹和铁血战士视觉滤镜，拍照和录像均可使用。提升拍摄稳定性和变焦流畅度，支持眼镜独立相机键和可选的滑动变焦。新增阿拉伯语和应用内语言选择，更新应用商店目录，并支持眼镜熄屏后继续传输文件。
